title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) misses practice Monday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Mayfield remains unlikely to return in Week 5 against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Porter should be good to go in his second game with the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: CeeDee Lamb (thigh) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Lamb will remain a locked and loaded WR1 for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Goodson (ankle) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Tyler Goodson was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Goodson should remain in his reserve role behind Javonte Williams in the Cowboys backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Smith (thumb) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Tyler Smith was listed as limited on Monday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Smith was designated to return to practice. He will have a chance to return for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) DNP in estimated practice Monday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown was listed as a DNP on Monday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Overshown remains hopeful to be ready for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Tuesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Mixon signs with Seahawks
items.desc: Joe Mixon is signing with the Seahawks after a workout on Monday.
items.impact: Mixon officially makes his return to the NFL.  The Seahawks have a clear opening with Jadarian Price on IR and Zach Charbonnet working his way back from an ACL injury. He'll be worth a stash for fantasy managers. This could hurt the value of Emmanuel Wilson coming off a big game on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Paris Johnson Jr. (torn bicep) out for season
items.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Paris Johnson Jr. tore his bicep and will miss the rest of the season.
items.impact: It is a brutal break for Johnson and the Cardinals offensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tank Bigsby (core) to be placed on IR
items.desc: Eagles RB Tank Bigsby suffered an injury on Sunday and will be placed on injured reserve.
items.impact: Bigsby now requires core muscle surgery to repair his injury. He is expected to miss at least 5-to-6 weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Donald (back) hopeful to return in Week 5
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said he is hopeful Aaron Donald will return in Week 5 against the Bills.
items.impact: The Rams play Buffalo on Monday, so Donald will have an extra day to get healthy. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb) day-to-day
items.desc: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said RB Kyle Monangai is day-to-day with his thumb injury.
items.impact: Monangai is coming off a huge performance in Sunday's win over the Jets. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) undergoing tests
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said RB Chris Brooks is still undergoing tests on an ankle injury.
items.impact: Brooks ran for 30 yards on four carries in Sunday's win over the Buccaneers. There should be an update on his status by Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Cisse clears concussion protocol
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Brandon Cisse already cleared concussion protocol.
items.impact: Cisse appears to be on track to being able to play in Week 5 against the Bears.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) will not return to practice this week
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Micah Parsons will not return to practice this week.
items.impact: Parsons remains week-to-week on having his practice window opened.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dont'e Thornton Jr. uncertain on returning to practice this week
items.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said he is unsure on WR Dont'e Thornton Jr. returning to practice this week.
items.impact: Thornton opened the season on injured reserve. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson (groin) expected to practice this week
items.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said Jackson Powers-Johnson is expected to practice this week.
items.impact: Powers-Johnson will have a chance to return in Week 5 against the Patriots.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jackson Sirmon to be elevated by Saints Monday
items.desc: The Saints are elevating LB Jackson Sirmon for Monday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Sirmon will add depth in the linebacker room for Monday's game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Fadil Diggs to be elevated by Saints Monday
items.desc: The Saints are elevating EDGE Fadil Diggs for Monday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Diggs will add depth for the pass rush for New Orleans on Monday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jammie Robinson to be elevated by Falcons Monday
items.desc: The Falcons are elevating Jammie Robinson for Monday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Robinson will add depth in the secondary for Atlanta.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cobie Durant (hamstring) will not return in Week 5
items.desc: Cobie Durant will not return for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: It is a short week for the Cowboys. Durant will be hopeful to return for Week 6.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyquan Thornton (ankle) to miss 12-to-16 weeks
items.desc: Chiefs WR Tyquan Thorntonwill miss 12-16 weeks.
items.impact: Thornton is having surgery "within the week" and is likely to miss the rest of the season. Xavier Worthy should be among the players to see more opportunity in his place.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marcus Mariota suffers sprained MCL
items.desc: Marcus Mariota suffered a sprained MCL in the Commanders' Week 4 loss to the Colts.
items.impact: Mariota sprained the MCL in the same knee during the preseason. He'll likely be sidelined in Week 5, which could lead to rookie seventh-rounder Athan Kaliakmanis making his first career start pending the status of Jayden Daniels (elbows).

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (knee) expected to miss 2-to-3 weeks
items.desc: 49ers FB Kyle Juszczyk is expected to miss 2-3 weeks with a sprained knee.
items.impact: Juszczyk will likely avoid being placed on injured reserve. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) status for Week 5 uncertain
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Monday he didn't know the chances of Lamar Jackson playing in Week 5.
items.impact: Minter added that he didn't think "it's going to be crazy long-term." Jackson will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) without update on injury
items.desc: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said he'll "have more answers Wednesday" on Saquon Barkley's hamstring injury.
items.impact: Barkley went down early in Sunday's game against the Rams. His status is up in the air heading into Week 5 against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (ankle) day-to-day
items.desc: Eagles EDGE Jonathan Greenard is considered day-to-day with an ankle injury.
items.impact: Greenard suffered the injury in Sunday's game against the Rams. His status will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) hopeful to return in Week 6
items.desc: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said he is "hopeful" Jaelan Phillips will be able to play in Week 6 against the Eagles.
items.impact: Phillips went down with the injury late in Sunday's win over the Lions. He'll have the bye week to try and get fully healthy.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Derrick Harmon (foot) lands on IR
items.desc: Derrick Harmon (foot) will miss at least the next four weeks on IR.
items.impact: Harmon was carted off the field in Thursday's loss to the Browns due to a foot injury. This is a blow to the Steelers' defensive front, as the 2025 first-rounder has already recorded 1.5 sacks and a forced fumble through four weeks.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: 49ers D/ST holds Broncos to 14 points Sunday
items.desc: The 49ers' D/ST allowed 14 points and 296 total yards while recovering one fumble in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos. San Francisco did not record a sack or interception.
items.impact: San Francisco didn't make many plays from a fantasy standpoint, but the defense did its job by keeping Denver out of the end zone until the fourth quarter. A special teams fumble recovery also helped set up San Francisco's first touchdown. The lack of sacks is worth monitoring, but the 49ers remain a viable fantasy defense heading into Week 5 against Seattle.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Eddy Piñeiro makes four kicks in win Sunday
items.desc: Eddy Piñeiro made one of his two field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos. His field goal conversion came from 24 yards out.
items.impact: Piñeiro finished with six points despite missing out on one field-goal opportunity. San Francisco continues to give him scoring chances behind one of the league's better offenses, which keeps him on the fantasy radar heading into Week 5 against Seattle.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Deebo Samuel scores touchdown in win Sunday
items.desc: Deebo Samuel caught five of his six targets for 26 yards and a touchdown, adding 44 yards on three carries in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Samuel didn't do much with his receptions, but his usage on the ground gave him a productive fantasy day. He averaged 14.7 yards on his three carries and scored San Francisco's first touchdown on a one-yard reception. Samuel's ability to produce as both a receiver and runner keeps his weekly upside high as a flex option.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: George Kittle scores long touchdown in win Sunday
items.desc: George Kittle caught four of his six targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Most of Kittle's production came on one play, but fantasy managers won't complain. He took a short pass 56 yards for a touchdown late in the fourth quarter to put the game away. Kittle remains a middle-of-the-pack TE1 in fantasy when healthy.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tee Higgins (adductor) listed day-to-day
items.desc: Tee Higgins (adductor) was labeled day-to-day by Bengals head coach Zac Taylor on Monday.
items.impact: Higgins had a huge game Sunday after fellow Cincy receiver Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) was knocked out of the loss to the Jaguars early. Higgins was clearly dealing with an injury of his own late in the game, however. It was later revealed to be an adductor issue, but it appears the injury is considered mild. Higgins should be monitored at practice this week.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Mike Evans leads 49ers in receiving Sunday
items.desc: Mike Evans caught five of his eight targets for 76 yards in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Evans didn't find the end zone, but he led San Francisco in both targets and receiving yards. He averaged 15.2 yards per catch and continued to make plays down the field despite playing through a rib injury. The volume remains encouraging for fantasy managers heading into Week 5 against Seattle to make Evans a WR3.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) in protocol, labeled day-to-day
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase is going through the league's concussion protocol.
items.impact: Chase will need to clear the protocol before having a chance to play Sunday in Miami, but it is a positive sign that head coach Zac Taylor said Monday that the star wideout is day-to-day. Chase was knocked out of Week 4's loss to the Jaguars early, leaving plenty of extra targets for Tee Higgins and the rest of the Bengals' route runners.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Kaelon Black sees six carries in win Sunday
items.desc: Kaelon Black rushed six times for 13 yards in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Black saw some work behind Christian McCaffrey but wasn't able to do much with it, averaging just 2.2 yards per carry. He remains a lottery ticket in San Francisco's backfield and doesn't have standalone fantasy value as long as McCaffrey is healthy.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Christian McCaffrey scores touchdown in win Sunday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey rushed 15 times for 52 yards and a touchdown while catching three of his five targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: McCaffrey didn't have his biggest day from a yardage standpoint, but he found the end zone on a one-yard run in the fourth quarter. He finished with 18 touches and remains the clear lead back in San Francisco. McCaffrey remains a must-start option heading into Week 5 against Seattle.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Brock Purdy throws two touchdowns in win Sunday
items.desc: Brock Purdy completed 19 of 30 passing attempts for 218 yards and two touchdowns, adding 29 yards on the ground in Sunday's 24-14 win over the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Purdy didn't put up a big yardage total, but he took care of the football and threw both of his touchdowns in the second half. He has San Francisco at 4-0 and continues to give fantasy managers a solid floor as a low-end QB1 in one of the NFL's better offenses. Purdy will face the Seattle Seahawks in Week 5.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Wil Lutz makes two field goals in loss Sunday
items.desc: Wil Lutz made two of his three field-goal attempts in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers. He connected from 52 and 40 yards before missing a 58-yard attempt late in the fourth quarter.
items.impact: Lutz gave fantasy managers six points despite Denver struggling to finish drives. The 52-yard field goal was encouraging, but he has now missed a field goal in back-to-back games. Lutz remains a viable fantasy option at kicker.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Evan Engram quiet in loss Sunday
items.desc: Evan Engram caught one of his five targets for six yards in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Engram had another disappointing performance despite seeing five targets. Turning those opportunities into just one catch for six yards isn't going to get it done for fantasy managers. The target volume at least gives him something to build on, but Engram will be difficult to trust in 12-team leagues or shallower until he starts producing more with his opportunities.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Courtland Sutton held to four yards Sunday
items.desc: Courtland Sutton caught one of his six targets for four yards in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Sutton had a rough day despite tying for the team lead among wide receivers with six targets. He and Bo Nix couldn't connect on several opportunities, leaving Sutton with just one catch. The volume remains encouraging, and fantasy managers shouldn't overreact to one bad game, but Sutton will need to bounce back first after his quiet Week 4 before entering starting lineups.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Pat Bryant records 47 receiving yards Sunday
items.desc: Pat Bryant caught all three of his targets for 47 yards in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Bryant made the most of his opportunities, averaging 15.7 yards per reception and finishing second on the Broncos in receiving yards. The problem is volume, as he saw just three targets. Bryant is worth monitoring, but he will need a larger role in Denver's passing game before becoming a reliable fantasy option upon his return to the field.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jaylen Waddle scores touchdown in loss Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle caught five of his six targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Waddle didn't put up many yards, but he saved his fantasy day with a 13-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter. He finished second on the team in receptions but was held to just 7.0 yards per catch. Waddle remains one of Denver's top options in the passing game and should continue to see enough targets to remain in fantasy lineups as a WR2.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: J.K. Dobbins, RJ Harvey struggle in loss Sunday
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins rushed 11 times for 40 yards, while RJ Harvey had seven carries for 25 yards in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers. Harvey also caught 10 passes for 68 yards out of the backfield.
items.impact: Denver couldn't get much going on the ground, with Dobbins and Harvey combining for just 65 rushing yards. Dobbins, however, continued to handle more of the rushing work. Harvey, meanwhile, was much more involved as a receiver and ended up leading the Broncos' offense in both receptions and receiving yards. The backfield remains a split, with Dobbins having the better chance at early-down work and Harvey carrying more upside in the passing game.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: RJ Harvey, J.K. Dobbins struggle in loss Sunday
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins rushed 11 times for 40 yards, while RJ Harvey had seven carries for 25 yards in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers. Harvey also caught 10 passes for 68 yards out of the backfield.
items.impact: Denver couldn't get much going on the ground, with Dobbins and Harvey combining for just 65 rushing yards. Dobbins continued to handle more of the rushing work, but Harvey was much more involved as a receiver and ended up leading the Broncos in both receptions and receiving yards. The backfield remains a split, with Dobbins having the better chance at early-down work and Harvey carrying more upside in the passing game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Darrisaw placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: Vikings OT Christian Darrisaw was placed in the NFL's concussion protocol.
items.impact: Darrisaw will likely miss some time. He'll have to clear all protocols before he can return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) to miss 2-to-4 weeks
items.desc: Bucs S Antoine Winfield Jr. has a rib fracture and is likely to miss 2-4 weeks.
items.impact: Winfield is considered week-to-week.
